subject.title: [Feature Request] Session List: Show timestamp + last message preview

question: Should the narrow Control UI session-list preview land now via the linked PR or a replacement, or be folded into the broader sessions workspace design?
rationale: The backend contract exists and the missing Control UI wiring is source-proven, but the linked external PR is conflicting/proof-needed and broader Sessions UX issues overlap the same display surface.

options.title: Repair or replace narrow PR
options.body: Use the existing `lastMessagePreview` contract to land the row preview independently, repairing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/48396 if practical or replacing it narrowly if not.

options.title: Fold into sessions workspace
options.body: Defer this row-preview request into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 so the preview, peek, status, and inline-reply design are decided together.

options.title: Defer UX change
options.body: Keep the issue open as product backlog until a maintainer explicitly prioritizes Sessions list ergonomics.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace narrow PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing `lastMessagePreview` contract to land the row preview independently, repairing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/48396 if practical or replacing it narrowly if not.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Sessions page and the existing preview contract both route through recent history tied to Peter Steinberger/steipete.
